description:
Built for riders who want high-performance capability in a lightweight, approachable package, the E Ride Pro PRO-S e-moto delivers up to 8 kW of peak power, a 49 mph top speed, and 0–30 mph acceleration in just 2.4 seconds. Its swappable 72V 30Ah battery provides 43+ miles of range at 25 mph or 65+ miles at 15 mph, depending on terrain, speed, and riding conditions.

With adjustable sport suspension, 16-inch or 17-inch wheel options, and a manageable 31.2-inch seat height, the PRO-S offers agile handling and confident control across trails, hills, and rugged terrain. Weighing only 127 pounds, this versatile off-road e-moto combines powerful performance with responsive handling to make every ride more exciting.

ULTIMATE PEAK POWER

Superior battery power, durable motor, and outstanding controller, altogether add up to the supreme capability for a powerful off-riding journey.

ALL TERRAIN & VERSATILE

E Ride Pro is built to be ridden off road, giving riders the versatility to conquer rugged landscapes with ease, as well as mountainous conditions for adventures into the wilderness.

ZERO EMISSION ENGINEERING

The finest, lightweight, non-polluting electric motorcycle ever made. An ideal choice for modern riders who embrace the future of ecological sustainability.
